title: Cornell faculty to begin voting on no-confidence resolution
summary: Cornell University faculty will vote on a no-confidence resolution against university administration regarding its handling of a 2024 campus fraternity gang rape report. This represents institutional governance and leadership accountability issues at a major state-adjacent research institution with potential implications for higher education policy and constituent trust.
